caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects placed against a plain, light beige background. One object is a cylindrical mortar with a slightly flared rim and base, featuring two horizontal grooves as part of its design. The surface exhibits natural wood grain patterns in varying shades of brown. The other object, lying in front of the mortar, is a pestle with a rounded, bulbous end for grinding and a narrower handle with carved decorative rings and a turned knob at the opposite end. The pestle's wood grain and coloration closely match that of the mortar, displaying light to dark brown hues. Both objects are rendered with a high degree of detail, showing subtle highlights and shadows that convey their three-dimensional forms and textures.
title: Mortar and Pestle
